title: Post
description: A post in a Lemmy community, representing a link, text, or image submission.

body.description: Text body content of the post (Markdown supported)

creator_id.description: ID of the user who created the post

community_id.description: ID of the community the post belongs to

removed.description: Whether the post was removed by a moderator

locked.description: Whether comments on the post are locked

published.description: Timestamp when the post was published

updated.description: Timestamp when the post was last updated

deleted.description: Whether the post was deleted by the author

nsfw.description: Whether the post is marked as NSFW

local.description: Whether the post originated on this instance

language_id.description: ID of the language the post is written in

featured_community.description: Whether the post is pinned to the community

featured_local.description: Whether the post is pinned to the local instance feed

thumbnail_url.description: URL of the post's thumbnail image

embed_video_url.description: Video URL extracted from embedded URL
